title: 48 MCT to 1mL Vial
author: Opentrons
materials: Specify your parameters on this page.
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Download protocol file
steps.instruction: Download the protocol file for the 48‑sample transfer from the provided link.

steps.title: Upload to OT App
steps.instruction: Open the OT App and upload the downloaded protocol file.

steps.title: Arrange deck layout
steps.instruction: Place labware on the OT‑2 deck exactly as follows: Slot 2 – Opentrons acrylic tube rack (samples 1‑24); Slot 3 – custom 1 mL tube rack with tubes (samples 1‑24); Slot 5 – Opentrons acrylic tube rack (samples 25‑48); Slot 6 – custom 1 mL tube rack with tubes (samples 25‑48); Slot 7 – Opentrons 300 µL pipette tip rack.

steps.title: Load pipette and calibrate
steps.instruction: Mount the P300 single‑channel GEN1 pipette, attach Opentrons 300 µL tips, then calibrate the pipette, tip rack, and all labware in the OT App (refer to the calibration‑tips support article).

steps.title: Run the transfer
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App; the protocol will use the P300 pipette to transfer 300 µL from each source well in the acrylic tube racks to the corresponding destination tube in the custom 1 mL tube racks for all 48 samples.
